title: Sleeping Moon
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Akihiko, 27, returns to his family's rural ancestral home to investigate a curse said to bring early death to the family's men. A time slip carries him 100 years back, where he meets Meiji-era student Eitaro, who resembles his cousin Ren, and the two work across time to uncover the family secret.
life_message: Facing a family's hidden past, rather than fleeing it, is how a curse is broken.
